response.sql:
WITH site_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    sm.zoneref,
    s.insurstat,
    AVG(sm.facetresmm / sm.geomdeltamm) as site_avg_ratio
  FROM scanmesh sm
  JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sm.zoneref
  WHERE sm.geomdeltamm IS NOT NULL 
    AND sm.geomdeltamm != 0
    AND sm.facetresmm IS NOT NULL
    AND s.insurstat IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY sm.zoneref, s.insurstat
),
status_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    insurstat,
    AVG(site_avg_ratio) as status_avg_ratio
  FROM site_ratios
  GROUP BY insurstat
),
kept_sites AS (
  SELECT 
    sr.zoneref,
    sr.insurstat,
    sr.site_avg_ratio,
    sa.status_avg_ratio
  FROM site_ratios sr
  JOIN status_averages sa ON sr.insurstat = sa.insurstat
  WHERE sr.site_avg_ratio > sa.status_avg_ratio
)
SELECT 
  ks.insurstat,
  AVG(ks.site_avg_ratio) as average_ratio,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ks.zoneref) as site_count,
  AVG(ks.site_avg_ratio - ks.status_avg_ratio) as average_excess
FROM kept_sites ks
GROUP BY ks.insurstat

assumptions.assumption: Records where geomdeltamm equals zero are excluded to prevent division by zero, treating undefined ratios as 'missing ratios' per the request.
